{
  "claimed": {
    "model": null,
    "sessionId": null
  },
  "evidence": [
    {
      "command": "memory/rulings.md (the standing rulings register) and goal the-deputy-acts-under-a-recorded-delegation (metasystem goal show --history --json via the serving engine: its intent, its next step, and its 96 entries made by Wido)",
      "level": "read",
      "observed": "Read the register's ruling ids R-1 to R-152-m1e. Checked closely: R-95-m1e as amended by R-152-m1e (only a grant naming delegated classes alone may run 30 days; this is enforced in GeneralAttorneyLimit and generalWithinBounds), R-142-m1e (the machine never overrules a person), R-143-m1e (a person's decision is preceded by its impact), R-104-m1e (tests use artificial clocks) and R-12. Goal decisions checked: decision E3 makes this goal the first delivery of 13 units in a fixed order, with only U3b2 built using --last. The branch holds exactly those 13 units; the budget and run-release effects are not built, matching the second-delivery split. No conflict."
    },
    {
      "command": "git diff 2b9c51f48d^ 2b9c51f48d; git show 5c5fe8abbd (the U3b2 unit commit); git diff 4deff99ad8...2b9c51f48d -- (the whole branch)",
      "level": "read",
      "observed": "The reviewed commit 2b9c51f48d adds only read records under records/reads. The U3b2 unit commit 5c5fe8abbd changes these files: situation.go (the Undelivered count), situation_compose.go (the line 'N decisions under a grant not yet sent to you' in the authority summary, plus a wake line), tick.go (decision delivery now also runs under the helm, fix N15), decision_report.go (the empty 'overrule:' suffix is left out, fix N16), overrule.go (the budget goal is taken from --id/--goal or from the effect's targets, fix N12), and intent_planning.go (grant show takes exactly one id, fix N13; display values and RFC 3339 JSON times, fix N14). Every changed file is an owner file named in the brief or in amendment AM10."
    },
    {
      "command": "Read the U3b2 brief: /Users/wido/agentic-tools-evidence/lane-test-20261009/briefs/the-deputy-acts-under-a-recorded-delegation-U3b2-brief.md (amendments AM1 to AM10, section H3, test T8c)",
      "level": "read",
      "observed": "Requirement H3: count the undelivered grant decisions over the full log using the delivery's selection without its day rule, and keep the 20 shown decisions. situation.go counts decisions that have a Grant and are not in decisions-delivered.json, over the full log ReadDecisions returns. This is the same predicate DeliverDecisions uses, minus the day rule. An unreadable delivered set is reported as a problem and is never counted as zero."
    },
    {
      "command": "go test -count=1 ./cmd/metasystem -run 'TestGrantShowListsItsActs|TestBudgetOverruleNamesTheGoal|TestGrantShowFormatsTieredExpiry|TestTheOverruleUndoesWhatItCan|TestALateDecisionIsReportedNextTime|TestAuditOutputLayout'",
      "level": "ran",
      "observed": "ok cmd/metasystem 44.4s"
    },
    {
      "command": "PATH=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin:$PATH go test -count=1 ./internal/steward -run 'TestTheSituationCountsUnsentDecisions|TestEveryDecisionIsReportedOnce'",
      "level": "ran",
      "observed": "ok internal/steward 1.5s. The first run failed only because the sandbox stopped the xcrun git shim from writing its cache file; with the Command Line Tools git it passed."
    },
    {
      "command": "Read internal/goal/root.go LiveAt; cmd/metasystem/intent_planning.go runIntentGrantShow",
      "level": "read",
      "observed": "A scoped grant's expiry date is live through that whole UTC day (LiveAt compares UTC days). grant show now renders it as midnight UTC of the next day, which matches LiveAt."
    },
    {
      "command": "Read cmd/metasystem/attorney_admits.go, attorney_class.go and internal/goal/root.go across the branch range",
      "level": "read",
      "observed": "Carries admits a class only when the grant names it and that class can still be granted, so a grant with no classes, or one naming a retired class, admits nothing. A delegated class needs a decision id that is not empty and has no whitespace. The 'goal release' stale-releases mapping is removed. The 30-day limit applies only when the grant names classes and every one of them is delegated. All of this matches the brief's amendments AM3 to AM5 and ruling R-152-m1e."
    }
  ],
  "findings": [
    {
      "change": "In the second delivery, when the budget class is mapped, check that a one-more-day child's result keeps its goal target, or fall back to the positional goal word.",
      "claim": "When the goal is given only as a positional word (goal budget G one-more-day), the budget overrule now finds the goal only through the decision's recorded effect targets. When the child's result carries an 'owner' data block, decision record stores that block instead of the targets, so the overrule line would come out empty for that form. Today this is inert: no budget act is mapped to a class until the second delivery (a-deputy-budget-and-run-release).",
      "class": "other",
      "evidence": "internal/humanauthority/overrule.go: the budget arm reads Effect.Targets and then only the --id/--goal flags. cmd/metasystem/intent_decision.go:186-192 replaces the targets with {owner: ...} when the child's data has an owner. attorney_class.go has no mapping for 'goal budget' on this branch.",
      "id": "N-1",
      "material": false,
      "relation": "not material under R-124 (Wido, 2026-09-25): the first delivery works and is safe without it, because no budget act can be delegated yet",
      "resolves": null,
      "severity": "low",
      "where": "metasystem/internal/humanauthority/overrule.go"
    },
    {
      "change": "None needed. Either keep it as a reasonable wake trigger or drop it if extra wakes are unwanted.",
      "claim": "U3b2 also adds an 'undelivered|N' line to the situation's wake fingerprint, which brief section H3 does not ask for. The steward wakes when the count changes, including when a delivery lowers it.",
      "class": "scope",
      "evidence": "internal/steward/situation_compose.go wake(): add(\"undelivered|%d\", s.Undelivered). The file is an owner file of U3b2.",
      "id": "N-2",
      "material": false,
      "relation": null,
      "resolves": null,
      "severity": "low",
      "where": "metasystem/internal/steward/situation_compose.go"
    },
    {
      "change": "Optionally assert that the authority part was found.",
      "claim": "TestTheSituationCountsUnsentDecisions does not fail if the page has no part named 'authority'. Its check runs only inside the loop over parts with that name.",
      "class": "weakened-test",
      "evidence": "internal/steward/situation_test.go: the check is inside `for _, part := range Compose(s).Parts { if part.Name == \"authority\" {...} }`, and nothing asserts that the part was found.",
      "id": "N-3",
      "material": false,
      "relation": null,
      "resolves": null,
      "severity": "low",
      "where": "metasystem/internal/steward/situation_test.go"
    }
  ],
  "gaps": [
    "The brief supplied no reviewedTree from a computed diff artifact. The value given is the tree of commit 2b9c51f48dc0dbb340bb205ae33b81f8567d27d0, read with git rev-parse.",
    "The earlier 12 covered units (U1a1 to U3b1) each had their own clean read (all LAND, zero material findings, per the goal's next step).     "No mutation runs were made for the U3b2 tests. Only the named tests were run, not the full packages."
  ],
